purpose: Original detailed environment atlases, copied unchanged. Source cells sampled at runtime; collision remains owned by the tile map.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for an ACTUAL cozy top-down pixel RPG: a transparent sprite atlas of EIGHT DISTINCT SMALL-TOWN BUILDING EXTERIORS. Original art with the rich hand-pixeled craft of classic 16-bit farming games: chunky individual pixels, intricate tiled roofs, warm wood grain, brick foundations, small flower boxes, ivy, copper gutters, chimneys, tiny details, attractive silhouette. Bright warm spring palette: burnt-orange, deep terracotta, sage/teal, honey wood, plum, warm cream. Crisp black-free dark brown outlines. NOT a flat vector icon, NOT crude boxes, NOT watercolor, NOT realistic 3D. Detailed but readable at 160 pixels wide. Pixel-level material shading and ambient occlusion. Orthographic view facing SOUTH with roof visible from above, no rotated/isometric buildings.
Strict uniform FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, exactly 8 isolated sprites, consistent size and baseline. Each building fills 95% of its equal rectangular cell, equal left/right minimal padding. No overlap between cells. All doors are at the exact BOTTOM CENTER of their building, both sides balanced, with an unobstructed entrance. Roof and façade together occupy the whole rectangular house silhouette. All eight have broad attractive gable/hip roofs with a shallow front facade and a visible centered front door. No ground/background, no scenery outside cell, TRANSPARENT alpha.
Row1 left to right: 1) FLORIST small cream timber shop, moss green tiled roof, flower baskets, rose vines, pink tulips, seed sacks. 2) BICYCLE WORKSHOP weathered light-wood walls, slate blue roof, metal chimney, hanging tools and a bicycle wheel emblem. 3) SCHOOL larger cream-brick school, blue-green roof, tiny bell tower, symmetric white framed windows, welcoming wide central door. 4) COFFEE SHOP terracotta tiled roof, warm plaster facade, sage striped awning, round coffee cup emblem, window boxes and glowing amber windows.
Row2 left to right: 5) OLD POST OFFICE honey timber, rusty red roof, little red post box, envelope pictogram sign. 6) LIBRARY teal shingle roof, timber plaster, tall bookish windows, open book pictogram sign. 7) FAMILY COTTAGE soft plum roof, pale warm wood, cottage window curtains, roses and a tiny chimney. 8) COMMUNITY NEWSPAPER pale ochre roof, brick-and-wood facade, newspaper pictogram and ink-blue window trim.
NO characters, NO lettering or words, NO grid lines/borders, NO watermark, no cast ground shadow. An asset sheet, not a scene. Keep row/column positions exact.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art environment sprite ATLAS for an actual top-down cozy village RPG. Original exquisitely detailed 16-bit farm-life game art, NOT crude minimalist rectangles. Warm spring colors, richly clustered leaves, organic asymmetry, hand-pixelled wood grain, crisp stepped outlines, thoughtful 2-3 tone lighting, top-left sunlight. Original game graphics with dark moss/umber outlines, no black outlines, no blur, no smooth vector, no painterly brushwork. Consistent orthographic three-quarter view from above facing south.
EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate objects in a strict uniform FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid, 1 object per equal square cell, transparent alpha all around, each object centered and fully inside its cell with 8% padding. Every cell at the SAME scale. Cell order must be exact.
Row1: 1 lush round deciduous spring-green oak tree with thick gnarled trunk and layered leafy canopy; 2 tall dark evergreen pine tree, tiered dense needles; 3 soft pink blossoming cherry tree with dense rose blossom canopy and visible trunk; 4 low dense flowering shrub with small pink and ivory flowers.
Row2: 1 wooden flower planter overflowing with pink, cream and gold flowers; 2 rustic wooden park bench with detailed slats and curved metal supports; 3 charming warm iron street lamp with amber lantern and small mossy base; 4 wide oval stone village fountain with clear turquoise water and central small jet.
Row3: 1 richly detailed wooden cafe counter with drawers, stone top, espresso machine, cups and glass jars; 2 round polished wooden cafe table with two small stools and a vase of daisies; 3 tall wooden bookcase full of colorful books, small plant on top; 4 child's classroom desk with open notebook and little tucked-in stool.
Row4: 1 cozy cottage bed with plum quilt, cream pillow, carved wooden headboard; 2 rustic wooden crate and sack arrangement with red and green produce; 3 weathered red mailbox on a wooden post with a tiny white envelope icon; 4 small picket fence segment with three honey-wood posts, flowers growing around the feet.
No characters, no landscape, no floor, no shadows outside sprites, no labels, no numbers, no border, no lettering, no watermark. All 16 silhouettes completely isolated, same camera/style and equal cells. Plain transparent background. This atlas will be cropped at runtime into actual interactive game objects.
